name: genesis-conductor-instinctv2-1
description: Instinctv2.1: public declassified version of Instinct.OS by Igor Holt (@invariantx) for Genesis Conductor agent OS research. AI Studio-derived application exposing core agentic OS primitives for local development and deployment. Provides foundational patterns for autonomous agent runtime, orchestration, and self-hosted AI surfaces that integrate with OpenClaw skills, persistent state, MCP bridges, and the full thermodynamic / diamondNode verification stack.
